crossRefs.note: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

people.name: Eden
people.line: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.

translations.web: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
translations.bsb: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
translations.kjv: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
translations.asv: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.
